description: Search what WarmInboxes publishes: cold email guides, deliverability playbooks, original studies and their datasets, costed infrastructure recipes, tool demo videos, inbox guides per sequencer and AI agent, provider comparisons, Claude skills, the changelog, and the offer and about pages. Searches titles and full text, and each match carries the passage that best answers the query. It holds WarmInboxes' own measurements (monthly inbox placement tests, sender reputation by TLD, a SURBL study) as well as guides. read_resource returns a whole page.

limit.description: How many matches, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

query.description: A question or topic, e.g. "warming up Azure inboxes" or "Smartlead".

type.description: Optional: only this kind of resource.

name: find_resources
title: Guides, playbooks, studies and videos
